name: Maverick Hunter - X
desc: If this card is Summoned: You can add 1 "Maverick Boost" card from your Deck to your hand. If a "Maverick Boost" card is activated while you control this face-up card (Quick Effect): You can target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; negate its effects. You can only use each effect of "Maverick Hunter - X" once per turn.
strings: Add 1 Maverick Boost card from Deck
